description: This Java class 'CpmFileModel' processes and parses CPM assembly files to extract components and organize them into a map keyed by package and value. It reads lines from a list, identifies component blocks, and extracts reference, value, and package information for each component, creating BomComponent objects accordingly.

classes.name: CpmFileModel
classes.description: A model class responsible for reading CPM files, parsing component information, and organizing components into a map.

methods.name: readCmpFile
methods.description: Reads a list of strings representing the CPM file, parses component data, and populates the componentsByKey map with BomComponent objects.

methods.name: parseValueLine
methods.description: Parses a line to extract the value component after the '=' sign and trims the last symbol.

methods.name: parseReferenceLine
methods.description: Parses a line to extract the reference component after the '=' sign and trims the last symbol.

methods.name: cutLastSymbol
methods.description: Removes the last character from the input string.
